name: Babbage OS
description: A BRC-100 native personal computing environment with a modern desktop, mobile home screen, wallet-persisted preferences, files, communication, productivity, and web apps.

groupPermissions.description: Encrypt and persist your Babbage OS workspace, use Stuff, and receive Metanet message and payment notifications.

protocolPermissions.description: Encrypt, decrypt, lock, and unlock your private Babbage OS profile.
Encrypt, decrypt, lock, and unlock files and folders in Stuff.
Authenticate to MessageBox and retrieve Metanet message and payment notifications.

basketAccess.description: Store and retrieve the encrypted Babbage OS profile token.
Store and retrieve encrypted Stuff filesystem nodes.

spendingAuthorization.description: Monthly authorization for encrypted Babbage OS profile and Stuff filesystem updates.
